name: Rothesay
method: tidetimes.org.uk Rothesay vs its own Millport (UKHO-derived), applied to our gauge-fitted Millport: median time difference, least-squares height fit
note: HW and LW heights each = offset + scale * Millport. HW is ~10 min before Millport's and scatters ~5 min round it. Kayak-grade, not for navigation.
calibrated_from: tidetimes.org.uk Rothesay vs Millport, 2025-10-01 to 2026-11-25 (every 3 day(s), 544 events) via tools/calibrate-shift.ts
